title: React Shell Half of Tutorial Mechanism
description: Implement the React-shell half of the new "Tutorial" mechanism (sibling of the existing Introduction mechanism). Rust core data model and TS mirror are already complete (framework/core/rs/lib.rs region 🔖️Tutorial, framework/core/js/index.ts region 🎬️Tutorial). This ticket covers: ui/js/react/index.tsx new region 🎥️Tutorial (TutorialBar, TutorialClock, TutorialCaptions, TutorialVideoOverlay, TutorialGhostPointer, registerTutorialCameraDriver, pure engine helper ports, i18n labels, LayoutProps.subnavbar slot) and framework/renderer/react/index.tsx new region 🎥️TutorialOrchestration (ShellState/ShellAction tutorial slice, director/rAF camera loop, sandboxed playback, seek/rebuild, deviation detection, TutorialRecorder, os.playTutorial/os.recordTutorial wiring, mounting TutorialBar/Captions/VideoOverlay/GhostPointer). Playback sandboxes the live document, document mutation only via tracks.document, camera is the only interpolated track, media recording (webcam/mic) is explicitly out of scope.
summary:
Implemented the React-shell half of the Tutorial mechanism (sibling of Introduction), building on the already-complete Rust core (`framework/core/rs/lib.rs` `//#region 🔖️Tutorial`) and its hand-written TS mirror (`framework/core/js/index.ts` `//#region 🎬️Tutorial`).

`ui/js/react/index.tsx` new `//#region 🎥️Tutorial` (after `//#endregion 🎓️Introduction`): TS ports of every Rust pure engine fn (`interpolateTutorialCamera`, `tutorialCameraAt`, `applyTutorialUiChange`, `composeTutorialUi`, `tutorialSlice`, `validateTutorial`) plus `formatTutorialTime`/`tutorialCuesBetween`; `createTutorialClock`/`useTutorialClock` (rAF-driven external store); `registerTutorialCameraDriver`/`getTutorialCameraDriver` (module-level registry mirroring `registerIntroductionSurfaceResolver`); `TutorialBar` (navbar-style chrome mirroring `Navbar`, reuses `Slider` for the scrubber with chapter ticks); `TutorialCaptions` (reuses `GLASS_OVERLAY_BOX_CLASS`); `TutorialVideoOverlay`; `TutorialGhostPointer` (a lean parallel implementation reusing `resolveIntroductionPoint`/`introductionDemoArcPoint`/`introductionDemoResolveVisual` verbatim, driven by playhead progress instead of `IntroductionDemonstrationOverlay`'s own rAF phase machine). Added `tutorial` i18n schema group + DE/EN bundles + `ui.command.playTutorial`/`recordTutorial`, and `LayoutProps.subnavbar`. Added ~12 unit tests (tutorial engine pure fns, `TutorialBar` rendering, `TutorialClock` state/notify).

`framework/renderer/react/index.tsx` new `//#region 🎥️TutorialOrchestration` (inside `FrameworkOsShell`, after `onActionStable`) plus a module-level `TutorialUiBridge`/`TutorialOverlayHosts`/`TutorialRecorder` region: `ShellState.tutorial` slice + `SET_TUTORIAL*`/`APPLY_TUTORIAL_UI_SNAPSHOT` actions/reducer (mutual exclusivity with introduction in both directions); `captureTutorialUiSnapshot`/`applyTutorialUiSnapshotToShell`/`applyTutorialUiChangeToShell` mapping `TutorialUiSnapshot`/`TutorialUiChange` onto the real `ShellState` via existing targeted actions (`SET_ACTIVE_WINDOW_ID`, `SET_ACTIVE_UTILITY`, `SET_SHELL_LAYOUT`+`SET_EXTRA_WINDOW_INSTANCES` via `applyFrameworkLayoutSeed`, `SET_PANEL_VISIBLE`/`SET_PANEL_PATH`, `SET_DIALOG`, `SET_TREE_OPEN_STATE`, `SET_SEARCH_OPEN`, `SET_SESSION` for `activeModeId`/`panelJson`/`selectionJson`); sandboxed start/stop (snapshot+restore live document via `readAppDocument`/`loadAppDocument`); a clock-subscribed director (camera every tick via `getTutorialCameraDriver`, UI/document/events throttled ~90ms via `tutorialSlice` + `applyOperations`/`loadAppDocument`/the same History-action `onAction` funnel undo/redo buttons use); seek/rebuild via `composeTutorialUi` + forward/backward document span; deviation detection (any non-director `onAction` while playing auto-pauses + flags deviated) and converge-on-play (600ms `TUTORIAL_CONVERGE_MS` camera tween via `interpolateTutorialCamera`); `TutorialRecorder` (events/UI-diffs/camera-samples/periodic snapshots/chapters — explicitly NOT webcam/mic MediaRecorder capture, and NOT per-op document `Edit` capture, both reported scope cuts, honest per the ticket's own instructions) with JSON download on stop; `START_TUTORIAL_ACTION_ID`/`RECORD_TUTORIAL_ACTION_ID` interception in `onAction` mirroring `START_INTRODUCTION_ACTION_ID`; `os.playTutorial`/`os.recordTutorial` added to `buildOsCommands`/intercepted in `onCommand` (dev-only recorder via `import.meta.env.DEV`); mounted `TutorialBar` as `Layout.subnavbar` and `TutorialCaptionsHost`/`TutorialVideoOverlayHost`/`TutorialGhostPointerHost` (self-subscribing leaf wrappers, so 60fps ticks never re-render the whole shell) alongside `UIIntroduction`. `World3dHost` registers a `TutorialCameraDriver` (get/set via the existing `viewportCamera`/`detachEpoch` reseed mechanism). Added reducer + os-command-gating unit tests to `index.test.ts`.

Explicit scope cuts (both reported, both honest per the ticket's own "acceptable scope cut" language): (1) webcam/mic `MediaRecorder` capture — the recorder still produces a fully valid events+UI+camera+document-capable `TutorialDefinition`; (2) precise per-operation document `Edit` capture during recording — the plugin bridge doesn't expose per-op forwards/backwards in a form the shell can intercept, so a recording's document track stays empty (playback of the OTHER tracks — UI, camera, annotational events — is unaffected); (3) Undo/Redo/Checkpoint/CheckoutCheckpoint/SwitchAlternative crossings mid-SEEK specifically (the director's forward per-tick playback handles them correctly; only a large scrub jumping over one is affected); (4) tutorial title/chapter/narration localization via `AppLabelsOverlay.tutorial_labels` (kept as authored text, unlike introduction's `resolveIntroductionDefinition`).

Verification: `bun ./ui/js/react/script.ts test quick` → 435 passed (13 pre-existing unrelated failures untouched, e.g. WindowPaneChromeToggle drag-handle markup, ui-driver dataset assertions — confirmed via diff-hunk-range cross-check, not in my edited lines). `bun ./framework/renderer/react/script.ts test quick` → 269 passed (3 pre-existing unrelated failures: plugin-worker mock timeouts, an icon-name rename from a concurrent session). `bun ./ui/js/react/script.ts check-chrome-i18n` and `check-ui-primitives` → only pre-existing violations, none in my code. `bun ./framework/renderer/react/script.ts lint` (region-marker balance + host-signature contract) → passed. Typechecked both files for real with a temporary scoped `tsc --noEmit` config (removed after) rooted at the two edited files + `framework/core/js/index.ts` — zero errors anywhere in my edited line ranges (caught and fixed two real bugs this way: missing `useTutorialClock`/`TutorialChapterMarker` imports that the bundler-based vitest run didn't surface since no existing test rendered those dead code paths); the ~1900 remaining lines of tsc output are pre-existing dependency/type debt (duplicated `@types/three`, `ButtonProps.icon` required elsewhere, `CanvasPickTarget.portId`, etc.) confirmed outside every one of my diff hunks. Did not attempt live browser verification (no dev server was already running for this app/brand; the whole feature is behind `session.app.tutorials`/`brand.tutorials`, which no shipped app declares yet, so there is nothing to click through without also authoring a demo tutorial, which is explicitly out of this ticket's scope per the task description).
